description: This file is a C++ source file implementing a mock or wrapper class for IARM bus operations, including functions for bus initialization, connection, event handling, and method calls. It appears to be part of a testing setup, as indicated by the inclusion of <gmock/gmock.h> and the use of EXPECT macros. The code manages a singleton-like implementation pointer and exposes several functions and function pointers for external use.

classes.name: IarmBus
classes.description: A class encapsulating static and instance methods to interact with the IARM bus system, including setup, event handling, and method invocation.
